title: Extension Capabilities Reference

# Extension Capabilities Reference

The registry of capabilities: the boolean settings every
program has, from its dialect and its `use` block. Prefix `LCAP`.

This document is the authoritative registry and composition reference.
It covers: every registered capability and its kind, the capabilities
with engine consequences, the composition rules and fundamental
constraints, the T_wcet impact of each combination, and the combination
matrix.

Companion specs (full details):
- `realtime` → [RTCT]
- `constspace` → [LCSP]
- `linear_scan: false` → [LNLS]
- `logical: false` → [LNOG]
- `dynamic_ttl` → [LDTL]
- `regex: false` → [LNRE]
- the other construct capabilities → [LFCA]
